signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all throws outside the numbers (except on high/low throws).
Passers with this ability are immune to throw penalties caused by defensive pressure while their feet are set in the pocket
Passers with this ability improve the catching prowess of all tight ends who are open on pass plays.
Ballcarriers with this ability have more powerful truck and stiff arm animations.
Avoid stumbling when carrying the ball
Ballcarriers with this ability will frequently attempt to gain extra yards while being tackled
Defenders with this ability force more catch tackle knockouts in man-to-man versus short routes less than 10 yards from LoS
Defenders with this ability have higher chance to catch uncontested interceptions, and they have unlimited stamina on the return (until using a special move or breaking a tackle).
Defenders with this ability force more catch knockouts and react quicker in deep zone coverage, 20+ yards from the LoS and outside the hash marks.
Aggressive receivers overpower defenders and attack the football. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their success rate on aggressive catches against single coverage.
When lined up at wide receiver (excluding slot), players with this ability have access to four additional hot routes during pre-play adjustments.
Receivers with this ability have a high success rate when creating separation on the last cut of any route.
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes less than 10 yards from the LoS, inside the numbers
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 20+ yards from the LoS, outside the numbers
